changelog.text: 25 more cosmetics. New hats: Propeller Cap (it spins faster when you run), Santa Hat, Wizard Hat, Chef Hat, Mushroom Cap and Samurai Kabuto. Laser Eyes, a Masquerade Mask and a Ninja Band with flowing tails. Unicorn Horn, Wolf Ears and Mouse Ears. A Peacock Fan and a Mermaid Fin. Bee, Void and Leaf Wings. Snowfall, Music Notes, Bubbles and Storm auras. And four more moving capes: Snowy Village, Equalizer, Lava Lamp and Fireworks.

Every cosmetic, remade. All 47 3D cosmetics are rebuilt from scratch with more detail and better movement: proper crowns and cowboy hats, feathered angel wings, bat-wing demons and dragons, fluffy tails, blinking frog eyes and a lot more. Plus 12 new ones: Viking Helmet, Astronaut Helmet, Pirate Tricorn, Phoenix Wings, Mech Wings, Orbiting Blades, Rune Circle, Kitsune Tails, Scorpion Tail, Antlers, Axolotl Gills and a Holo HUD. And five new moving capes: Thunderstorm, Code Rain, Hyperspace, Koi Pond and Phoenix.

Smoother. With everything switched on, Lmg now uses about a third less of the game's time: cosmetics work out their lighting once instead of every frame, settling snow skips what's behind you, animated capes only update when someone can see them, the fairy wings are half as heavy with the same look, and the minimap stops re-mapping land it mapped a moment ago.

Play with friends (Essential). The app now installs Essential too, so you can host your single-player world and invite friends, or join theirs, without a server. The title screen has a Play with friends button that opens Essential's friends list, and the pause menu has Essential's invite button. Essential asks you to accept its own terms the first time. Don't want it? Switch it off in the app's Mods tab and it stays off, even when it updates. App 1.3.2.

Share codes stay yours. Config codes and uploaded configs no longer carry your personal settings (your UID, friend nicknames, friends and sharing switches, menu position, crash-report choice). Old codes still work.

Crash reports. If the game crashes, the next time it starts it asks if you'd like to send the crash report so it gets fixed: Send, Always send, or Don't send. Your name, account ID, folder names and IP are taken out first. Change it any time in Menu > Help > Crash reports. The app (1.3.1) has a Just update button next to Play, for updating without starting the game.

Skeet menu drags properly. Moving the menu by its top bar in the Skeet style now takes the grey group boxes along with everything else (they used to stay behind). The "Accent on Skeet/Neverlose" switch is now called "Use my accent" so it fits in its box.

Capes that move. Every Lmg cape is animated now: the aurora ripples, the galaxy turns, flames flicker and embers rise, petals fall, waves roll, fireflies blink, the synthwave grid scrolls, clouds drift and the racing flag moves. Other Lmg players see yours move too. Don't want it? You > Outfit > Animated capes. The 1.8.9 edition (1.0.1) gets moving capes as well.
